pages.title: Columbian Mammoth
pages.text: The Columbian mammoth ($(o)Mammuthus columbi$()) is an extinct mammoth that lived in North America during the Pleistocene, from the northern United States to Central America.$(br2)It was one of the largest proboscideans, standing up to four metres tall at the shoulder, with enormous curved tusks.$(br2)Living in warmer regions than the woolly mammoth, it likely had a much thinner coat. It grazed on grasses and sedges and disappeared at the end of the Pleistocene.
